development_only.post.digit_expansion: BIGNUM_LEXPAND_CONV / BIGNUM_EXPAND_CONV with the hand-picked LAND_CONV/RAND_CONV traversal is the human expansion idiom.
development_only.post.side_condition_order: The order of the congruence's side conditions (bounds first, case split last) follows the human proof; HOL does not force it.
development_only.simulation.split_for_sub: The sub routine is simulated in two carry chains with the borrow flag injected between them. The split point is derived from the flag's source step, but splitting at all follows the human proof.
development_only.simulation.step9_cleanup: RULE_ASSUM_TAC(REWRITE_RULE[WORD_UNMASK_64; NOT_LE]) after the CSETM step rewrites the flag-only step; copied from the human sub proof.
